description: This file defines classes and templates for managing dynamic argument lists used in formatting functions within the fmt library, including handling of reference wrappers, argument storage, and argument pushing mechanisms.

classes.name: node
classes.description: A template struct representing a node in a linked list, with a virtual destructor and a unique pointer to the next node.

classes.name: dynamic_arg_list
classes.description: A class managing a linked list of typed nodes for storing formatting arguments.

classes.name: dynamic_format_arg_store
classes.description: A class template that stores a list of formatting arguments with support for small string optimization and dynamic argument handling, used in the fmt library.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds a new argument node to the dynamic_arg_list.

methods.name: operator basic_format_args<Context>()
methods.description: Converts the argument store into a basic_format_args object for formatting.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Adds an argument to the dynamic_format_arg_store, handling copying and reference semantics.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves space for a specified number of arguments and named arguments.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of stored arguments.
